applicabilityBasis.summary: Cloudflare announces a planned 1:1 USD-backed payment stablecoin for automated web commerce.

genius.notes: Cloudflare, Inc. is the announced sponsor. The exact legal issuing entity, authorization and issuer pathway are undisclosed in the inspected announcement and product FAQ. Cloudflare sponsor identity is not evidence of issuer authorization. The 1:1 backing promise and generic stablecoin definition do not establish a token-specific reserve report or holder redemption policy. No comprehensive negative authorization search is claimed.
